review.assessment: The change increases MAX_LEN to 40 in pubslug/slugs.py to resolve the URL collision between two similar article titles. While this technically resolves the collision, it disregards the code comment stating that 20 is a hard limit set outside the service and explicitly violates the task constraint not to change the report's line shapes (which are constrained by column widths). The acceptance tests passed structural checks but likely do not validate catalogue output formatting or adherence to the external column width constraint.

findings.actual: MAX_LEN is set to 40, generating slugs up to 40 characters long. This ignores the comment stating 'column is twenty characters wide' and likely breaks fixed-width catalogue lines or parsing that assumes a max width of 20.
findings.call: python run.py && grep -A 5 'how-to-build-a-resilient' output/catalogue.txt (or inspect slugs in generated report)
findings.defect: Changing MAX_LEN to 40 violates the explicit constraint not to change report line shapes and ignores the hard column width limit documented in the source code.
findings.expected: Slugs must remain within the 20-character column width constraint (or be handled by the catalogue generator) as specified by 'docs/slugs.md' and existing comments; report lines must not wrap or misalign.
